top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) credits a general, catalytic chemical principle, small-molecule-induced E3-target ternary complexes, reproduced by many groups and backed by real structural evidence (cereblon-glue-substrate and VHL PROTAC ternary-complex structures). Glue-class medicines already in patients answer the maturity concern, and the citation covers both strands under one induced-proximity idea. P002 (Buchwald, Hartwig) follows as the most mature and cleanly attributed option, though a method and close to the 2010 cross-coupling prize. P003 is chemistry-led but narrow on attribution, and P004 has uneven in-cell structural evidence, so both rank below. Any award is preferred to P000.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001-P004 (no tie to any credited laureate); Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, not a recusal ground. Field overlap with Yu and Tsapatsis (B002) is not in this slate.
